description: Create a project after approval of the reference label and published app URL. project_name is a reference label, not the home-screen app name; that starts as the website hostname until configured. Duplicates by reference label or site host return candidates: ask the customer to choose create_new or use_existing with project_code; never reuse automatically. For an owner preview, pass from_preview_id to read editable prefill, then submit its observed_website_link. A same_site_project conflict requires explicit link_existing:true with project_code or false to create separately.

duplicate_choice.description: Customer choice after reviewing duplicate candidates; never infer consent.

from_preview_id.description: Owner preview. Alone reads editable prefill; submit with name, URL and observed_website_link to create or return transactionally.

link_existing.description: Explicit same-site choice after same_site_project: true links selected project_code, false creates separately.

observed_website_link.description: Exact URL read from project_prefill; preserves the portal concurrency guard.

project_name.description: Approved reference label, at most 120 characters; not the app’s home-screen name.

website_link.description: Full published app URL on a site the customer owns; not an editor or builder-share link.

name: bdk_create_project
title: Create project
